caption: The drawing consists of a rectangular swatch of woven fabric positioned in the center of a beige background. The fabric swatch displays a plaid pattern made up of horizontal and vertical stripes in three colors: red, blue, and green. The stripes intersect to form a regular grid of squares, where the colors overlap to create variations in hue. The edges of the fabric swatch are slightly frayed. Above the swatch and slightly off-center, there is a handwritten word "above." In the lower right corner of the background, the typed name "PAUL KELLEY" appears in small, thin lettering. The overall composition is centered, with the fabric as the main focus against an otherwise plain and unadorned backdrop.
title: Textile Sample
